name: linear_decode_forward
description: Linear-attention decode step. For each batch b with slot_idx[b]!=-1, computes state=k[b,:,0] outer v[b,:,0]+exp(-slope_rate[h])*kv_caches[slot_idx[b],h] in float32, writes the new state back into kv_caches, and returns out[b,h*d:(h+1)*d]=q[b,:,0] dot state. A slot_idx of -1 skips both the cache update and the output row; output contents for such rows are unspecified by the current implementation. Returns (out,kv_caches), where kv_caches is the same storage as the input and is mutated in place. Shapes: q/k/v [B,H,1,D], kv_caches [num_slots,H,D,D], slope_rate [H], slot_idx [B], out [B,H*D]. BLOCK_SIZE is accepted but unused. Current tests exercise float32 with B 1..8, H 2..8, D 32..128.
